in_sanskrit.name: बिनुद्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has the power of knowledge and wisdom, the embodiment of subtle knowledge and intelligence

in_marathi.name: Binud
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wise, Intelligent, Knowledgeable
in_marathi.long_meaning: Binud हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Binud means one who is full of knowledge and wisdom. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Binod' which consists of 'Bina' meaning intelligence and 'Ud' meaning filled. In Hindu mythology, Binud is a name for Lord Vishnu and Lord Krishna, symbolizing their divine wisdom and knowledge.
